title: “Send to CandidatAI” button
intro: Saves the job you are looking at in one click, on LinkedIn, InfoJobs or any website, and completes the LinkedIn jobs that arrive as a summary.

browser.question: Which browser do you use?
browser.unsupported: The extension works in Chrome, Edge and Brave. To use it, open CandidatAI in one of them.
browser.openIn: You are in a different browser: open CandidatAI in {{name}} to install and connect it there.

outdated: You have an old version of the extension ({{installed}}; this app's is {{current}}). On the browser's extensions page, press the reload button (⟳) on its card.

steps.use: Pin it to the toolbar and use it

install.folder: Open the extension folder to see where it is. It is the one you will pick in step 4 (its path is there, ready to copy).
install.noFolder: The extension folder was not found in this installation. Reinstall CandidatAI.
install.page: In a new tab, paste this address and press Enter:
install.devModeEdge: Turn on Developer mode (in the left panel).

load.windows: Click {{button}}. A window to pick a folder opens: click the address bar at the top, paste this path, press Enter and then Select Folder.
load.mac: Click {{button}}. A window to pick a folder opens: press Cmd+Shift+G, paste this path, press Enter and then Select.
load.linux: Click {{button}}. A window to pick a folder opens: press Ctrl+L, paste this path, press Enter and then Select.
load.whole: Pick the whole extension folder, without going into it or opening any file inside.

install.update: If you already had it loaded, do not load it again: press the reload button (⟳) on its card.
install.waiting: Waiting for you to load it. When you do, this page moves on to the next step by itself.

connect.body: One click and you are done: CandidatAI gives the extension a key that only works on this computer. You do not have to copy anything.
connect.done: Connected: the extension can now save jobs to CandidatAI.
connect.againHint: Only needed if you switch browsers: connecting again disconnects the previous one.
connect.noAnswer: The extension did not answer. Reload it (⟳) on the extensions page and press “Connect” again.
connect.rejected: The extension could not connect. Press “Connect” again.

use.pin: Press the puzzle icon in the browser toolbar and the pin next to “Enviar a CandidatAI” (its name in the browser, in Spanish), so it is always at hand.
use.pinEdge: Press the Extensions button in the browser toolbar and the eye icon next to “Enviar a CandidatAI” (its name in the browser, in Spanish), so it is always at hand.
use.send: Open a job (for example, on LinkedIn while signed in) and press the button. It tells you whether it is new, whether it completed a summary or whether you already had it, with a link to its page.
use.selection: If it cannot find the description, select the job's text with the mouse, company included, and press again.

privacy: It only acts when you press its button, on the tab in front of you: it does not crawl pages, does not read your cookies and only talks to CandidatAI on your computer. LinkedIn's terms forbid extensions that copy its content; this one saves only the job you ask for, as if you copied and pasted it, but that ban is still in their terms.

demo.alt: Animation: a job open on LinkedIn, a click on the “Send to CandidatAI” button in the browser toolbar, the new-job notice and the job already in the CandidatAI Inbox.
